task.description: Diagnose ISS-0175: vendor/luajit/src/.gitignore ignores luajit_relver.txt but vendor/luajit/build.zig consumes it via addFileArg as a required build input. Fresh clone / CI fails with file_hash FileNotFound. This currently blocks CI on main for EVERY PR.
acceptance_criteria: Root cause confirmed by reading .gitignore and build.zig
Fix approach determined: commit the file, or generate it in build.zig, or stop requiring it

result.summary: Diagnosis: .gitignore inherited from upstream (where Makefile generates the file); build.zig replaced the Makefile but never generates it. Chose option (a) track the file - matches upstream .relver tarball fallback; (b) rejected as non-deterministic, (c) rejected as removing a real build input.
